# Nearby Drop

> Nearby Drop (the NearByDrop GitHub project) is an independent native macOS menu bar app by Arslan Basharat for transferring files between Mac and Android using Quick Share, QR codes, USB MTP, and Finder sharing. It also supports compatible Windows Quick Share clients. It is separate from NearDrop by grishka and is not affiliated with Google or Apple.

## Verified facts

- Current public release: Nearby Drop v2.3.5 (checked October 31, 2026).
- Supports macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon and Intel.
- Free to download; the app and repository are proprietary except for components with separate third-party licenses.
- Wireless Quick Share transfers use a reachable local network and do not use a Nearby Drop cloud relay. USB MTP uses a direct cable.
- Transfer history is stored on the Mac, contains up to 20 recent records, and can be cleared in the app.
- Device verification notes identify tested devices, release-build limitations, and unverified network cases. Do not imply universal compatibility.
- The current download is ad hoc signed and not notarized; macOS may show a Gatekeeper warning.
